name: Jixiangornis
isnote: Described as close to Jeholornis; Lefèvre et al. (2014) found it closer to Pygostylia, while Wang et al. (2020) kept it among jeholornithiforms.
sum: Toothless long-tailed avialan from the Yixian Formation of China, known from one juvenile skeleton.
holotype: A complete but juvenile skeleton from the Yixian Formation near Beipiao City, western Liaoning.
biology: Long forelimbs (131 percent of the hindlimb) suggest at least some aerial ability; its toothlessness evolved independently of modern birds.
author: Ji et al. 2002
